task.description: Validate test design for SH-05 and SH-06. HARD GATE. Verify: (1) SH-05 MUST has at least 2 runnable tests (fallback on error, reset works), (2) SH-06 SHOULD has at least 2 runnable tests (banner hidden/visible), (3) no test.skip on MUST tests, (4) no MSW or HTTP mocking beyond page.route(), (5) unit tests isolated (no backend). On PASS set next_action to Route to TEST-RUNNER (Step 4).
acceptance_criteria: SH-05 MUST covered by unit tests (RTL)
SH-06 SHOULD covered by E2E tests (Playwright)

result.summary: Test design for SH-05 and SH-06 passes all hard-gate checks. SH-05 (MUST): 4 unit tests in ErrorBoundary.test.tsx cover fallback render, reset mechanism, no-error path, and re-throw after reset. SH-06 (SHOULD): 3 Playwright E2E tests cover banner absent on 200, banner visible on 503, and banner auto-dismissal on recovery. No test.skip, no MSW, unit tests import only RTL/Vitest/React/component under test. All RTL/Vitest/jsdom dependencies confirmed present in web/package.json.
